description: This file extends and customizes account journal and move line models in an OpenERP/Odoo module, adding date validation logic and a new boolean field.

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Extends account.journal with an 'allow_date' boolean field and default allowing date outside period.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Extends account.move.line with a check_date method to validate move date against period constraints.

methods.name: check_date
methods.description: Validates that the move date is within the period unless 'allow_date' is set to True.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to include date validation before saving.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides create method to include date validation before creating a record.
